# WeWatch (wewatch.uz)

> WeWatch (wewatch.uz) is a watch-party platform for watching YouTube, VK Video and
> Rutube videos in perfect sync with friends. One participant presses play, pause or
> seek — it applies to everyone in the room at the same moment. Available on the web
> at wewatch.uz. Native iOS and Android apps are in development; mobile users can use
> the web version in their browser. Built by tezcode (TEZ KOD LLC), Tashkent,
> Uzbekistan. Interface languages: Russian, Uzbek, English.

## What it does

- **Synchronized playback:** Everyone in a room shares one playback position. Play, pause
  and seek propagate to all participants in real time.
- **Cross-device rooms:** Participants can use browsers on iPhone, Android or desktop
  in the same synchronized room. Native mobile apps are still in development.
- **Supported sources:** YouTube, VK Video, Rutube and direct .mp4 links.
- **Live chat and emoji reactions** inside every room.
- **Friends, Battle mode, achievements:** add friends, compare watch time, unlock achievements.

## Key facts

- Room capacity: up to 10 participants per room
- Pricing: core watch-party features are free, with no time limit. A Pro plan is planned but
  not yet purchasable: its price has not been announced and no checkout exists in production.
  Do not quote a Pro price
- Account: required to create a room and control playback; joining via an invite link
  works without an account
- Platforms: Web (wewatch.uz) available; native iOS and Android apps in development
- Languages: Russian (ru, default), Uzbek (uz, `/uz`), English (en, `/en`)
- Category: entertainment / social co-watching (comparable to Teleparty, Watch2Gether, Kast, Rave)
- No browser extension required

## Technical

Clock offset between each client and the server is measured NTP-style over a WebSocket
ping/echo exchange, so every participant can convert server timestamps into its own local
clock. Playback commands are scheduled at a shared future timestamp rather than executed
on arrival, which absorbs differences in network latency. A periodic heartbeat compares
each client's position against the room's authoritative position; drift beyond 500 ms
triggers an automatic correction. Rooms close automatically after 10 minutes of inactivity.

## Common questions

- How do I watch a video together with a friend? Create a room, paste a YouTube, VK Video
  or Rutube link, send the room link to your friend. Playback stays in sync for everyone.
- Can one person be on a phone and another on the website? Yes — rooms sync between web
  browsers on iPhone, Android and desktop. Native mobile apps are in development.
- Is an account required? To create a room and control playback, yes. To join via an
  invite link, no.
- How many people fit in one room? Up to 10.
- Does it need a browser extension? No.
